pages.text: An Extreme Assembly Table that needs nobody. Push the ingredients of one craft in from any side - an AE2 $(thing)Pattern Provider$() with a processing pattern (inputs: everything the recipe takes; output: the result), pipes, hoppers - and it finds the Extreme recipe they make, lays them out itself and crafts. The result (and anything a recipe leaves behind) waits in its output; pull it out from any side.

Every Extreme recipe works, including the ones that follow the game (the Omniscience Catalyst, singularity clusters, specimen bundles, the Compendium and the Harvest). Those are matched by exactly what was delivered, so give their patterns blocking mode. Use the block to see what it is doing.
